displayName: Get alerted when new applications come in
summary: Get a fit summary for every new application automatically so nothing slips through.

useCases.title: Get alerted when new applications come in
useCases.message: Set up an application monitoring routine. If you don't already know which role and inbox to monitor, ask me. Then set up a Routine that checks for new applications and sends me a summary of who applied and a summary of how their background compares to the job description.
